name: Dead Tide - Director's Cut
source:
The beautiful Dead Pirate Queen Jessenia seeks, rum, song and debauchery in the little known tavern... the Salty Snatch. Join us for a peek into how a pirate Queen spends her time ashore...

[From [url=https://affect3dstore.com/dead-tide-director-s-cut.html]Official site[/url]]

"Director's Cut" is the visual novel version of the title, which was previously only available as a digital comic.
